statement: At the certified descent floor N_0 = 162849448 (J-residual-floor-one-hundred-sixty-two-million) the parity 6/5 table plus the reduced-base walk charge of J-cyclemin-walk-transport exclude every cycle length L ≤ 478244: any nontrivial Juggler cycle has period at least 478245. The parity table leaves 25 leftovers through L = 6·10^5 (data/research/juggler/cycle_walk_charge/new_floor_parity_leftovers.json); the 15 below the blocker (176251 through 454572) are all walk-killed with certified margins 1.198 (176251, 352502) up to 8.437 (202032); SHA-256 of the 15 kill records concatenated in length order is 148180cbbfba93985b7a1be455fee16db97816f1534b1feca5a4740d475aeda0 (data/research/juggler/cycle_walk_charge/new_floor_kills/). Lengths L ≤ 176250 are covered because both exclusions are monotone in the floor (J-cyclemin-walk-charge-instance at 26254995; for fixed (L, o) the parity rhs and the reduced-base DP budget strictly decrease as N_0 grows). First survivor L = 478245 = 176251 + 301994, the k = 1 member of the F1 semiconvergent fan: required improvement 19.46 against walk supply ≈ 7.7, DK break-even floor 3.48·10^8 (J-cyclemin-walk-competition-law) — the blocker is Diophantine, not computational. Supersedes the cutoff 176250 of J-cyclemin-walk-charge-instance (factor 2.71). Printed as Corollary 5.10 of Paper A (docs/theory/juggler_finite_dynamics_note.md), with the certificate, parity-scan, and kill-table hashes in its Appendix B. Same trust boundary as Theorem 4.6: exact human inequalities plus guarded float comparisons. Not a halt theorem and not a no-cycle-of-any-length theorem.
